Inter NationSpeaking Practice

Speaking Cards

Pre-Intermediate Speaking Practice · 10 Topic Cards. Each card has two parts — short warm-up questions, then longer questions to speak in full sentences. Tap a question, write your own answer, then tap Easy or Hard to see a sample answer. Your answers save automatically.

Card A Childhood Memories Card B Personality & Social Life Card C School & Education Card D News & Media Card E Weekend, Home & Food Card F Weather & Money Card G Internet & Technology Card H Health & Career Card I Skills & Personal Growth Card J Travel & Languages
How to use this card. Each card has two parts. In Part 1, answer short warm-up questions. In Part 2, speak in full sentences, using the linking words because and for example where you can. You can also use the sample answers as a model, then say it in your own words!

Childhood Memories

Part 1 · Warm-up Questions
1What is your favourite memory from when you were a little kid?✓ written
Sample answer

My best memory is playing outside with my friends. We played football and other games every day. We had a lot of fun.

My favourite memory is playing outside with my friends. We usually played football and other games. We had a lot of fun together.

YOUR ANSWER
2What did you enjoy doing when you were younger?✓ written
Sample answer

I liked playing with my friends and watching cartoons. I also liked going to my grandparents’ house. It was always fun there.

I enjoyed playing with my friends and watching cartoons. I also liked going to my grandparents' house.

YOUR ANSWER
3Where did you live when you were a child?✓ written
Sample answer

I lived in Tashkent. There was a small park near my house, and I played there with my friends.

I lived in Tashkent. My house was near a small park where I played with my friends.

YOUR ANSWER
4What was your hobby when you were a child?✓ written
Sample answer

My hobby was playing football. I played with my friends after school, almost every day.

My hobby was playing football. I played it quite often with my friends after school.

YOUR ANSWER
Part 2 · Speak in Full Sentences
1How did people use to communicate in the past without mobile phones?✓ written
Sample answer

People wrote letters or talked face to face. They also used home phones to call each other. If friends lived far away, they wrote long letters.

People used to communicate face to face or by letters because they didn't have mobile phones or the internet. They also used home telephones. For example, people often wrote letters to friends and family who lived far away.

YOUR ANSWER
2Did people use to have more time for family in the past?✓ written
Sample answer

I think yes. There was less social media, so families talked more. For example, they often had dinner together and talked about their day.

I think they used to have more time for family because there were fewer phones and less social media. People spent more time talking to each other. For example, families often had dinner together and talked about their day.

YOUR ANSWER
3Describe a place you liked spending time when you were a kid.✓ written
Sample answer

I liked my grandparents’ house. It was quiet and comfortable, and I could relax there. I often played outside and had lunch with my grandparents.

I liked spending time at my grandparents' house because it was a comfortable and peaceful place. I could play and relax there. For example, I often played outside and had lunch with my grandparents.

YOUR ANSWER
4Speak about a habit you want to give up/stop, but you can't.✓ written
Sample answer

I want to use my phone less. I check social media too much, even when I don’t need to. Sometimes I use it in bed before I sleep.

I want to stop using my phone too much because it takes a lot of my free time. I sometimes use it even when I don't really need it. For example, I sometimes check social media before going to bed.

YOUR ANSWER

Part 2 · Speak in Full Sentences
1Is it better to be an introvert or extrovert?✓ written
Sample answer

I think both are fine. Extroverts like meeting people, and introverts like quiet time. For example, an extrovert enjoys parties, but an introvert prefers to stay at home.

I don't think one is better than the other because both personalities have good sides. For example, extroverts may enjoy meeting people, while introverts may enjoy quiet activities and thinking deeply.

YOUR ANSWER
2What are the main personal characteristics of introverted people?✓ written
Sample answer

Introverts are usually quiet, and they like being alone. They feel good in calm places. For example, they prefer reading at home to going to a big party.

An introverted person is usually quiet and likes spending time alone because they feel comfortable in calm situations. For example, they may prefer reading a book at home instead of going to a big party.

YOUR ANSWER
3What are introverts good at?✓ written
Sample answer

They’re good at listening and working alone. They can focus on one thing for a long time. For example, an introvert can study well alone.

Introverts can be good at listening and working independently because they often like focusing on one thing. For example, an introverted student may study well alone and pay attention to small details.

YOUR ANSWER
4Do introverts have any problems?✓ written
Sample answer

Yes, sometimes. They can feel uncomfortable around many people. For example, speaking in front of a big group can be hard for them.

Sometimes they can have problems in social situations because they may feel uncomfortable around many people. For example, an introvert may find it difficult to speak in front of a large group.

Sample answer
